title: TypeScript: Types & Working with Data
description: Наступний крок після основ: методи масивів, власні типи й інтерфейси, union і literal types, enum, деструктуризація, generics, утилітні типи та безпечна робота з unknown. Саме ці інструменти щодня використовують в автотестах на Playwright.
goals: Transform test data with map, filter, find, some, every, reduce and sort
Describe data with type aliases and interfaces
Use optional and readonly properties and index signatures
Model states with union and literal types and narrow them safely
Use enums and as const objects for fixed sets of values
Destructure, spread and collect values with rest
Write reusable generic functions and types
Use utility types (Partial, Pick, Omit, Record…)
Handle unknown data from APIs with type guards
